info.title: SunCharts EHR Clinical API
info.description: API specification Apache-2.0; implementation AGPL-3.0-only. Synthetic development preview. This contract is served by each independent SunCharts EHR installation and covers its native REST, bounded FHIR R4, scheduling, billing, EDI, webhook and practice-owned integration surfaces. Tenant/user identity is derived from authenticated credentials. OAuth2 authorization code with S256 PKCE, scoped opaque tokens and explicit local consent permits independent clients; optional SunCharts Connect routes add onboarding and managed services but are not required for the instance-local clinical, scheduling, billing, clearinghouse or integration APIs. Provider callbacks retain their endpoint-specific verification and are not general unauthenticated writes. FHIR R4 projections and bounded Patient, clinical-list, local draft ServiceRequest and Immunization writes form an initial HL7-family boundary; no general HL7 v2 interface, US Core, SMART App Launch, Bulk Data or ONC claim. Legacy HS256 assertions require ENGINE_ALLOW_LEGACY_GATEWAY=true. Imports preserve source history and never authorize cutover. No automatic mutation retries.

put.description: While the visit is in progress, the practice's clinical staff may save the note: the assigned clinician, any other clinician, the owner, and an enabled nurse or medical assistant. Front desk and read-only staff may not, and a custom access policy without clinical edit blocks it. A delegated support session may save a draft. The visit does not have to be assigned to the writer. project_id.description: Required; dot and double-dot identifiers are rejected.

workspace_id.description: Optional; dot and double-dot identifiers are rejected.

endpoint_slug.description: Optional endpoint slug; omit for direct routing. Dot and double-dot identifiers are rejected.

model.description: Required and nonblank when saving or using a connection. Discovery may omit it, use null or an empty string. Other values must have no surrounding whitespace or control characters; at most 120 UTF-8 bytes.

CarePathwayAiConfiguration.description: Optional configuration for ai_extract_draft and ai_response_draft nodes only. Both kinds require manual_approval=true. Dispatch approval precedes provider execution; generated output retains its separate human-review gate. The run patient_id supplies optional local identifier context; it cannot be overridden by dispatch input and is not sent as an internal ID to the provider.

integration_id.description: Non-nil clinic AI connection ID; validated against the selected draft purpose at execution.

instruction.description: Nonblank instruction, at most 4000 UTF-8 bytes; NUL rejected.

source_field.description: Explicit JSON pointer into the workflow context, at most 200 UTF-8 bytes. Only ~0 and ~1 escapes are allowed. Empty pointer, control characters, configuration and credential path segments are rejected.

AiDraftMetadata.description: Shared Claude/Erebine draft metadata. No tenant ID, request digest, source text or credential. List responses omit generated content and exclude requesting drafts.

content.description: Generated draft text, bounded to 131072 UTF-8 bytes; null while requesting or failed.

CarePathwayAiPrivacyPolicy.description: Mandatory invariant for every Sun workflow request. Legacy nodes default to this policy. Alternate modes or any disabling value are rejected; local replacement mappings never leave the EHR.

integration_id.description: Explicit clinic-owned Claude or Erebine connection; omission is allowed only when exactly one eligible connection exists.

patient_id.description: Optional tenant patient used only for local identifier detection and revision binding. A linked pathway supplies its trusted patient; any explicit patient must match.

AiPrivacyPreview.description: Single-use preview valid for 15 minutes and bound to tenant, reviewer, exact input, selected connection/model, credential configuration, patient revisions and optional workflow revision. Mapping and original input are stored locally in encrypted form and never returned by this preview. Review remains necessary; detection is not a guarantee that all identifying text was found.

patient_id.description: Local review context only; not part of outbound provider content.

instruction.description: Exact sanitized instruction approved for the provider request.

source_text.description: Exact sanitized source text approved for the provider request. Supported clinical codes remain intact.

AiPrivacyApprovalRecord.description: Attributed privacy evidence without replacement mappings. Historical drafts may contain an empty object.

limitations.description: Human-readable limits of local identifier substitution.

permissions.description: Resource keys: clinical, scheduling, billing, claims, communications, workflows, ai, integrations, practice, terminology, migration, events. Omitted permissions deny. Native role ceilings still apply; writes require view.

module_order.description: All supported module keys once. Legacy layouts missing only the four formerly fixed tools are normalized on read/write.

chart_tabs.description: Native chart area keys; overview required. Omitted areas remain hidden. Functional status and specialty care are independently selectable built-in areas; no specialty bundle is required.

specialty_workspaces.description: Legacy presentation input, accepted for compatibility. An empty array preserves the previously hidden specialty navigation entry by adding specialty to hidden_modules. New requests use hidden_modules and chart_tabs independently. Normalized responses and new revisions omit this field; existing stored revisions remain unchanged.

CopayReceiptInput.description: Confirmed payment already received. Receipt date cannot be in the future. Nonblank reference is required for check/external. Does not initiate a card or bank transaction.

hosted_checkout.description: Present for processor-verified hosted receipts. Manual void/reversal is rejected; verified provider refunds govern their accounting. Test receipts cannot be allocated in production.

CopayReceipt.description: Immutable receipt evidence plus current allocation/void state. Reversing an allocation does not refund funds or make the original receipt reusable.

PatientInvoiceService.description: Saved full line total for the quantity; do not multiply line_total_cents by units again.

PatientInvoiceActivity.description: Patient-only ledger evidence at issuance. Negative effect reduces balance. Internal staff reason/notes are not copied.

PatientInvoiceSnapshot.description: Immutable issuance snapshot. Format 2 adds itemized services, patient activity and payment/adjustment subtotals. These fields are absent in older saved snapshots; clients must show original totals with an explicit unavailable-itemization message, never rebuild old invoices from current records.

NewFhirPatient.description: Creation subset: identifiers are assigned by the server; omit identifier, id and meta.

copay_receipt_id.description: Server-assigned source receipt for an automatic appointment copay allocation.

BillingEntryContent.description: Stored ledger content, including server-attributed receipt or provider evidence. Unlike NewBillingEntry, it is not accepted as a write payload.

checkout_url.description: Available only for an open attempt permitted in this environment.

channel.description: `hosted` for a Stripe-hosted Checkout link, `reader` for a card payment taken on a reader. For a reader payment `last_result` says where it stands: `reader_waiting`, `reader_offline` or `reader_finishing` while open; `reader_declined`, `reader_cancelled`, `reader_timed_out`, `reader_offline`, `reader_in_use`, `reader_unavailable` or `reader_failed` once closed (`expired`).

reader_id.description: The card reader for a reader payment.

HostedCopayOperation.description: Immutable appointment/payment binding with durable reconciliation state. Receipt creation requires independently retrieved account/mode-bound captured charge evidence. Browser return and Checkout opening never count as payment.

reader_id.description: A card reader from GET /api/v1/billing/payments/readers. When present the payment is taken on that reader instead of a Stripe-hosted Checkout link.

evidence.description: Canonical allowlisted Claim.MD response fields, including senderid, sender_name, response_time, status and message. Acknowledgment is not payer acceptance or payment.

ClaimTracking.description: Read-only evidence scoped to the exact tenant and claim. Eligibility matches frozen coverage, member, payer and service date. Remittance posting does not imply zero balance. No GET triggers provider calls or accounting changes.

config.description: Exact server-signed ONLYOFFICE configuration. Token, scoped source URL and callback capability are sensitive and must not be logged.

OfficeEditorSession.description: Scoped to the current authenticated browser session, patient, document, immutable base file version and document metadata revision. A metadata or encounter-link change requires reopening the editor. Only a matching save_request_id with status saved confirms an EHR save.

DocumentFileAnnotation.description: Normalized top-left page rectangle; x+width and y+height must not exceed 1. IDs must be unique in the version. PDF page numbers start at 1; images require page 1. Stored overlays are displayed by the file viewer and do not modify or redact the underlying binary.

text_content.description: Only populated for text/plain. Other file bytes require the authenticated preview/download endpoints.

DocumentFileVersion.description: Immutable working copy, original version 1, or an appended version. Metadata versioning is independent; actor and reason are retained per saved copy.

DocumentFileVersionPage.description: Latest 100 appended versions descending, followed by preserved original version 1. truncated indicates older appended versions were omitted.

text_content.description: Only for a text/plain original, limited to 200,000 UTF-8 bytes. Cannot be combined with non-null content_base64.

content_base64.description: Optional new binary of the same MIME type, 1 byte to 10 MiB. Omit both content fields to retain the chosen base bytes while changing annotations.

DocumentFileSave.description: Append a working-file version using If-Match of the current FILE version, not metadata version. Original and prior copies are immutable. Exact retries replay their existing version; changed content with the same request ID or a stale file version conflicts. Only active documents accept saves. Annotation overlays are allowed only on PDF/PNG/JPEG.

EraPayerIdentity.description: Retained payer-loop source identifiers. Unique REF*2U resolves the payer code; a different XV plan ID is preserved separately. Explicit legacy PI may resolve only when 2U is absent; contradictory PI/2U or multiple different 2U IDs are rejected. Payee/claim REF segments never determine payer identity.

EraSupplementalEvidence.description: Retained informational elements without segment tag, in original order, scoped to zero-based claim/service or provider summary. Segment-specific shape and numeric values are validated. No extra payment, PR charge or adjustment is generated from these fields. CLP/CAS/SVC/BPR balancing remains mandatory.

SecondaryCoordinationRequest.description: Explicit original secondary preparation on the same posted account. parent_id identifies its adjudicated primary claim. Requires current native delivered primary details and active posted primary ERA (CLP1; CLP19 crossover refused), same services, active effective secondary coverage and reviewed paid units/crossover/payer timing. No ledger mutation. Corrections inherit frozen coordination from the secondary parent.

reason.description: Nonblank reason without control characters; recorded with actor and time.

version.description: Starts at 1 for an active chart without lifecycle events.

url.description: HTTPS source URL; no embedded credentials

modifiers.description: Exact ordered modifier tokens; normalized uppercase, comma separated, at most four two-character tokens. Blank is a separate key.

multiplier_basis_points.description: Explicit percentage in basis points: 10000 means 100%. Rounded half up to unit cents before multiplying by units.

default_for_scope.description: Explicit owner choice allowing this setting as default for the provider/facility/date scope.

reviewed_scope_and_sources.description: Must be true for approval; never implied by saving a draft.

content.description: Immutable proposal plus server-captured directory_snapshot (provider and facility IDs/names/versions). List responses omit entries and supply entry_count.

PracticeFeeSnapshot.description: Server-generated immutable approved fee evidence. Includes schedule_id, entry_key, unit_amount_cents, expected_line_amount_cents, actual_line_amount_cents, units, service_date, context, approved schedule scope/source metadata, source entry, override_reason and recorded_by. Unchanged saved line evidence survives retirement and directory changes. Supplied client snapshots are discarded.

CrossoverTrackingRequest.description: Reviewed received-secondary835 crossover linkage, mutually exclusive with coordination and source_history_id; frequency original, parent_id exact adjudicated primary. Requires current posted primary CLP19 and delivered primary details, current effective secondary coverage, and a staged/reconciled unbound original835 with exact payer, N1 PE XX billing NPI, original control, payer claim number, DTM472 service date, ordered service controls/codes/modifiers/charges and balanced paid/CAS. Secondary CLP2/20/4 supported. Creates tracking-only submitted record with frozen source evidence and external-control alias, never an outbound submission or ledger posting. Existing active same-payer originals and active source bindings block duplicates.

provider_name.description: Explicitly reviewed provider last name or organization name if needed by the payer. Never inferred from a display name.

session.description: Verified hosted Checkout ID/URL, SetupIntent ID/status and payment method ID only. No card credentials.

provider_status.description: Local recovery response only: no broker setup reservation found. This is not verified payment-method evidence.

reader_id.description: A card reader from GET /api/v1/billing/payments/readers. When present the payment is taken on that reader instead of a Stripe-hosted Checkout link.

channel.description: `hosted` for a Stripe-hosted Checkout link, `reader` for a card payment taken on a reader. For a reader payment `last_result` says where it stands: `reader_waiting`, `reader_offline` or `reader_finishing` while open; `reader_declined`, `reader_cancelled`, `reader_timed_out`, `reader_offline`, `reader_in_use`, `reader_unavailable` or `reader_failed` once closed (`expired`).

reader_id.description: The card reader for a reader payment.

anyOf.description: Verified hosted Checkout id/url/status, explicit authorization_accepted and sanitized subscription. No card data or client secret.

cancellation_available.description: List-only capability: verified local membership mapping and current scheduling/billing-edit permission.

anyOf.description: Original accepted input for the same currently authorized initiating actor only. No credentials, return URL or account binding.

subscription.description: Sanitized subscription from this verified native membership.

name.description: The name the practice gave this reader.

busy.description: The reader is taking a payment right now.

PracticeStaffInvitation.description: Sign-in status of one staff member on an installation whose sign-in is handled by SunCharts Connect. No invitation link or token is ever returned.

status.description: can_sign_in: has accepted or has signed in. waiting: invited, not yet accepted. expired/cancelled: the invitation can no longer be used. not_sent: the last attempt did not go out (see reason). not_invited: no invitation on record. access_off: their Connect membership is inactive. unknown: Connect could not be read. disabled: access is turned off here.

version.description: Current staff record version after an invitation attempt was recorded in its history.

NoteSaved.description: Who last saved the note, set by the server on every save. Values sent by a client are ignored.

name.description: Display name when saved; empty when the practice has no record of the person. A delegated support session is named Support staff.

support.description: Present and true when a delegated support session saved the note.

NoteAuthorship.description: Who a visit's note belongs to and what the caller may do with it. No note text.

name.description: Provider or staff display name; empty when none is recorded.

is_assigned.description: The visit is assigned to the caller.

signed.description: The person who actually signed. May differ from assigned.

delegated.description: The caller is a delegated support session. It may draft but never sign or amend.
